definitions.core_exact_time: same normalized symbol and equal core interval, with venue/direction recorded separately
definitions.core_overlap: same normalized symbol and any shared core bar; not a duplicate declaration
definitions.duplicate_review_candidate: same venue plus core overlap; review candidate only, never automatic label transfer
definitions.future_visible_overlap: both future-reference visible canvases intersect, including their main history
definitions.indicator_prefix: SMA/EMA initialization histories are not included in visible-window overlap counts
definitions.intervals: half-open [first_bar_open, last_bar_open + 15 minutes); adjacent intervals do not overlap
definitions.main_overlap: both currently displayed main-image time intervals intersect
definitions.original_w200_variant_overlap: old timestamp-verified W200 pre-holdout portion intersects the union of all new training variants
definitions.owner_box_core_overlap: old original Owner horizontal interval intersects new training core
definitions.same_source_core_identity: same source_path, exact core interval and direction; not proof of equal pixel/label geometry
